text: A Lambda function can run for up to 900 seconds (15 minutes) per invocation.
Lambda memory can be set from 128 MB to 10,240 MB, and CPU power scales with it.
The default Lambda function timeout is 3 seconds.
All AWS customers get the automatic protection of AWS Shield Standard at no additional charge.
Shield Standard defends against the most common network and transport layer DDoS attacks.
A Shield Advanced subscription covers standard AWS WAF fees for the resources it protects.
EC2 Auto Scaling replaces an unhealthy instance with a new one to keep the desired capacity.
An Auto Scaling group never goes below its minimum size or above its maximum size.
EC2 Auto Scaling balances instances evenly across the Availability Zones of a group.
CloudFront delivers content through a worldwide network of data centers called edge locations.
By default, a file stays in a CloudFront edge location for 24 hours before it expires.
CloudFront origin access control (OAC) sends authenticated requests to an Amazon S3 origin.
A CloudWatch alarm can notify an Amazon SNS topic when a metric breaches its threshold.
CloudWatch preserves alarm history for 30 days.
By default, CloudWatch Logs keeps log data indefinitely unless you set a retention period.
DynamoDB on-demand mode bills per read or write request, with no capacity planning.
An on-demand DynamoDB table with zero traffic is not charged for any throughput.
The maximum DynamoDB item size is 400 KB, and attribute names count toward it.
